status_meaning.adapted: Native equivalent retains the meaningful component capability; not signature or browser pixel parity.
status_meaning.consolidated: Capability is represented by shared types/builders, explicit Val/Emit, or a higher-level native component.
status_meaning.native_substitution: Browser-specific mechanism is intentionally replaced by a native control, command, semantic property or page-owned layer.
status_meaning.partial: Known substantive capability remains unresolved or unverified; see referenced gaps. A named entry point is not completion evidence.

policies: 517 upstream symbols are each listed once; public method declarations count as functions.
DOM attrs, selectors, global popover IDs, browser keyboard/hover mechanics and CSS anchors are not introduced into Minimoon.
Actions use Cmd/Emit, values use Val; mutable signals and JavaScript bridge authoring stay private.
Native form names cover actual native controls. Supply form(values=...) for custom controlled widget values and on_reset for resetting application state.
Real-host evidence remains pending; no completion status here asserts Developer Tools validation.

capability_gaps.description: Rich trigger/close policy/custom parts and touch delay/arrow parity are being extended; base native overlays work but these options are not yet verified.
capability_gaps.resolution: Shared OverlayScope/provider/parts implement rich content, close reasons/policy, delay/arrow and forced mount; advanced composition/interaction tests passed.

capability_gaps.description: Rich item/shortcut/destructive presentation, close_on_select overrides and controlled menubar selection require final implementation/tests.
capability_gaps.resolution: menu_customize/group/shortcut and menubar_controlled add rich menu presentation, close-on-select policy and selected root control; advanced composition tests passed.

capability_gaps.description: Uploading/error state, media variant, size and orientation are being extended.
capability_gaps.resolution: attachment.mbt implements all five upstream states, sizes/orientation/media and native busy/invalid semantics; two native/JS tests passed.

capability_gaps.description: Native swiper behavior exists; compound controls and exposed count/navigation state are under implementation.
capability_gaps.resolution: CarouselScope/provider/parts expose state, command controls, rich slides and both orientations; seven navigation/sidebar/carousel tests passed on native and JS.

capability_gaps.description: Initial/programmatic open must use per-opening measurement and invalidate stale close/reopen results.
capability_gaps.resolution: Select uses the shared per-opening floating_bounds helper; external/initial open and close/reopen stale responses covered by native/JS tests.

capability_gaps.description: Skyline/Developer Tools execution has not been performed. Automated native/JS tests and generated-host checks do not establish a real-host pass.
